release-guard-review.name: release-guard-review
release-guard-review.prompt: Perform the independent implementation review required by the approved preflight/status + CI release guard PRD. User approved "Preflight/status + CI release guard (Recommended; roughly 3–5 engineering days)" and autonomous parallel completion. Only EPIC-004 review is assigned here. Snapshot overlays exactly the six EPIC-004/PRD paths from local commit e0a402ffb55fb366e0b6abeebf3b13b97b216d64 onto published baseline 12e4829c22c46e6ad7dbec117f06fd3ed71380be. Main server/dashboard work is unrelated and absent. Read docs/projects/feature-memory-preflight/feature-memory-preflight.prd.md v1.2, particularly Part B, then review scripts/ci_policy.py, .github/workflows/release.yml, .github/workflows/pypi.yml, tests/ci_workflows.py and docs/INSTALL.md against baseline. Verify exact SHA/workflow/event/repository/latest-attempt/full-job qualification, rerun races, API pagination/errors/timeouts and bounded waits, strict tag resolution, report-mode nonpublication, every first GHCR digest push/manifest/GitHub release/PyPI upload gated, tag-first order, all existing tests/gates retained. Don't merely trust new tests; look for counterexamples. Run python tests/ci_workflows.py and python tests/content_budget.py with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Bounded in-memory fake probes are allowed, no source changes or full builds/benchmarks/live release dispatches. Distinguish blockers from low-priority suggestions and document exact file:line evidence, consequence/reproduction and smallest fix; if none, explicitly say none and list remaining verification limits (live branch missing/qualified dry runs pending). Check PRD inconsistency if it affects implementation acceptance, not speculative style. Only write assigned report. No subdelegation/PR/push to main or tags/publication/config changes. Parent will synthesize this review; you must not implement fixes.
